description: This file provides functions for managing user profiles and skills using Supabase as backend, including fetching, updating, adding, and removing profile data and skills.

methods.name: emptyToNull
methods.description: Converts empty strings to null for optional fields.

methods.name: requireAuthedUser
methods.description: Ensures the user is authenticated via session or token, returning user info or error.

methods.name: getProfileAndSkills
methods.description: Fetches current user's profile and skills from the database.

methods.name: saveProfile
methods.description: Upserts the current user's profile data into the database.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds or updates a skill for the current user with specified proficiency.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill by id or name for the current user.
